dct_description_sm: THIS IS A GEOREFERENCED FILE. A faint and largely incomplete map of Victoria. The land is divided into numbered plots of land arranged in a street grid with some names of the streets labelled including Government, Wharf, Store, Yates, View, Broad, and Fort Streets.
